narration.full_text: Welcome to our lesson on pairs of linear equations in two variables. By the end of this session, you'll understand the general form of these equations and how to create them from real-world scenarios. We'll explore both graphical and algebraic methods, including substitution and elimination, to solve these systems. You'll also learn to identify conditions for unique, no, or infinitely many solutions, and apply these concepts to solve practical problems. Let's dive in!
